cities.note: name 16 B @0; x u16@58 / y u16@60 on the logical grid (same space as unit coords; per-file garrison/terrain support in garrisons_measured / city_terrain_measured); tail shorts @86-91 measured, e.g. Roma (5, 5, 8) — NOT the city size: a size-like short sits in the two bytes immediately BEFORE each name (Roma 29 = its in-game size), i.e. at the final short of the preceding 92-B slot; exact field boundary open
cities.garrisons_measured: 0/8 cities have a unit on their exact tile (measured on this file)
cities.city_terrain_measured: 0/8 cities on non-ocean terrain, 0 on ocean, 8 outside the stored grid (measured on this file)

fields_proven.owner_u8@15: civ: 0=barbarians, 1..7=players (civ_names[n-1]); bit 0x10 = leader unit (Pope Leo I)
fields_proven.id_u16@36: per-save unit id (re-assigned on every save)
